name: The Myth of Arden - The Lonely Woodie
author: CharithaGG
description: 2D platformer game developed as an entry for Woodie NFT Art Contest. NOTE: Please use arrows/ws to navigate through buttons and space/return to confirm the action. Keys to play: [A] [D] [SPCE] [ENTER] [O/LEFT CLICK] [P/RIGHT CLICK]
